Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected Q2 spike on onboarding - billing review request

Hi Kimberly,

We saw a very large usage spike on our June invoices tied to a batch connector run during onboarding. Our finance team is flagging this as likely duplicate ingestion from the initial migration and asking whether Redwood can review and, if validated, issue a retroactive adjustment or staged service credit.

Attached is a short csv with the suspect meter lines (meter_export_Q2.csv). We don't expect ongoing over-usage, this looks confined to the week of June 14-20. Can someone confirm where this came from and propose next steps?

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz

Elena,

Thanks for the data and flagging this. Leaving a quick note while I loop in finance (Marissa) and the account lead (David).

Preliminary read: the ingest pattern you highlighted matches a short-lived duplication we observed during a connector retry window on June 15. We will:
- Marissa will run a usage reclassification to confirm duplicated tokens and calculate a proposed credit amount.
- We'll propose a staged credit schedule so Brightvale can smooth the adjustment across the next two invoices.
- If you prefer a single credit, we can do that as well — will include both options.

Marissa / David: can you take point on validation + draft credit note (and include VAT handling for the EU sales seat if needed)?

Kimberly Park

Team / Elena,

I've validated the meter lines Elena sent against our ingest logs and token accounting. Summary:
- Root cause: duplicate ingestion from an automated retry in the Brightvale S3 connector between 2026-06-15T02:10Z and 2026-06-15T02:34Z.
- Quantified impact: 1,362,450 extra generated tokens (net of normal traffic) that were billed on invoice INV-20260630.
- Gross charge impact: $5,449.80 before taxes.

Recommendation (two options):
1) One-off credit: issue a single credit note for $5,449.80 (plus VAT where applicable). We'll attach credit_note_Q2_Brightvale.pdf and reissue the corrected invoice.
2) Staged credit: split into two credit transactions across the next two monthly invoices (2 x $2,724.90) to help your cashflow. We will add a short memo on the ledger referencing the original invoice number for audit trails.

VAT / tax note: Because Brightvale has EU operations, we'll apply VAT treatment per your tax profile. If you need the credit to be grossed-up or show a separate VAT reclaim line, confirm the EU billing seat and VAT ID and we'll route to tax ops.

Next steps:
- Elena: please confirm whether you prefer option (1) or (2) and supply any VAT ID for EU seats.
- David: I'll prepare the credit note PDF and an internal Journal/AR entry.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: credit_note_Q2_Brightvale.pdf (pdf, 6 KB)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightvale.com>

Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear options. We'll take option (2), the staged credit across the next two invoices — that works best for our cash plan. EU VAT seat is Brightvale EU (VAT ID: EU123456789). Please route VAT accordingly.

Also, we need the credit memo reference on our AP system (please include original invoice INV-20260630 and your credit note id). If you can send the DocuSign link for the credit memo acceptance, our AP can sign and process.

Appreciate the help — Elena
